During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered the location of an administrative base for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dankayo/Legends|Dankayo]] ordered the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], and [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] to '''bombard''' it. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] learned of the impending assault and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] ordered the evacuation of the base. After this successful evacuation, [[Imperial Armored Transport]]s [[Elusive (transport)|''Elusive'']] and ''[[Timely]]'' recovered sensitive intelligence in the the ruins of the base. As the Imperial transports prepared to leave the [[Dankayo system/Legends|Dankayo system]], they were attacked by the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] ''[[Bonderium]]'' that had been stolen by the rebels. The ''Elusive'' escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] before it could be destroyed, dumping its garbage before it did so. Shortly, the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Momship]] ''[[Thrifty]]'' entered the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] to retrieve the rubbish. An [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] [[Black Hole-class Salvage Dreadnought|battle-wagon]] soon appeared as well and engaged the Squibs over control of the garbage dump.
